title: Es gibt… und dieser, diese, dieses
summary: Point at the world with es gibt (there is/are) and dieser/diese/dieses (this) — your first live taste of the accusative

blocks.title: es gibt — 'there is / there are'
blocks.body: *es gibt* is your all-purpose way to say **there is / there are** — and it always takes the **accusative**. For **feminine** and **neuter** nouns nothing changes: *es gibt eine Bäckerei, es gibt ein Café*. But **masculine** flips: *der Park* → *es gibt einen Park* (not *ein Park*). This is your first live taste of the accusative — the full picture lands in Week 3.

blocks.title: dieser, diese, dieses — 'this'
blocks.body: *dieser/diese/dieses* means "this" and matches the noun's gender just like *der/die/das*: **dieser Mann** (m), **diese Frau** (f), **dieses Kind** (n). And yes — masculine flips the same way as an accusative object: *dieser Park* → *diesen Park*.
blocks.callout: Same pattern as der→den — once it clicks once, it clicks everywhere.

pairs.note: Masculine always flips to *-en* in the accusative, whatever article family it's from.
Feminine never changes — same form in nominative and accusative.

blocks.explain: *der Supermarkt* is masculine, and after *es gibt* (accusative) it flips to *einen Supermarkt*.

blocks.hint: das Café doesn't change after es gibt.
blocks.explain: Es gibt ein Café hier — neuter *das Café* looks the same in nominative and accusative.

blocks.scene: Lena points out spots in her neighborhood as you walk through Neukölln.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.nl: Guck mal, hier gibt es einen Park.
lines.spotlight: *hier gibt es* — "here there is", a natural way to point something out.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.nl: Diese Straße hat viele Cafés. Es gibt auch eine Bäckerei, meine Lieblingsbäckerei.
lines.en: This street has lots of cafés. There's also a bakery, my favorite bakery.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Und dieses Gebäude? Es ist schön.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.nl: Ja, alt, aber schön. Hier gibt es viel zu entdecken.
lines.en: Yes, old, but nice. There's a lot to discover here.
